description:
RoadOut is a story-driven action-RPG that combines twin stick action with rubber-burning driving mechanics. Explore a vast post-apocalyptic world in your car, then battle your way through puzzle-filled dungeons on foot.

Work for hire, thrash rival gangs, and race for glory as Claire, a mercenary who survives by executing sabotage, delivery, and murder contracts in The Dead Zone. 

Out now on PS5!
